title: NVBit Unmapped Memory Range Exclusion
description: Per-(kernel, op-class, instruction-pc) sidecar emitted by the NVBit tracer when it encounters a memory operation whose target address falls outside any allocator-tracked memory range. AC4 requires that such instructions are recorded as a typed exclusion rather than silently emitted with a default allocation id (which would bias the downstream coalescer / HRD profiler toward unowned memory). This schema is the offline-checkable surface for that exclusion path.

schema_version.description: Sidecar schema major version. Pinned to 1; a deliberate schema bump must update both this constant and consumers in lockstep. A different value is a contract violation, not a configuration.

kernel_unique_id.description: Tracer-assigned unique id for the kernel function whose instruction was excluded. Matches `instruction.function_unique_id` and `kernel.function_unique_id` in the trace proto.

device.description: Compute capability tag of the device that produced the trace (e.g. `sm_86`, `sm_120`).

slug.description: Kernel slug from the workload roster (e.g. `gemm_hmma_bf16_sm80`).

excluded_op_class.description: Memory operation class the tracer was attempting to emit when the address fell outside any allocator-tracked range. Uppercase string form of the `MemoryOpClass` enum in `instruction.proto`. `TMEM` covers Blackwell (sm_100) tensor-memory accesses via the `tcgen05.{ld,st}` family. `UNSPECIFIED` covers the case where the classifier could not match the opcode against any known prefix; the schemas mirror each other for symmetry even though `unmapped_memory_range` is typically only emitted for the 3 supported classes (GLOBAL, SHARED, LOCAL) once allocation lookup misses.

instruction_pc.description: Virtual program counter of the static instruction. Matches `instruction.vpc` (or, for legacy emitters, `instruction.pc`).

count.description: Number of distinct dynamic instruction-instances of this static PC whose target address fell outside any allocator-tracked range. Aggregated per (kernel, instruction_pc) so the sidecar does not blow up on hot loops.

typed_reason.description: Pinned to `unmapped_memory_range`. A different value is a contract violation.
